name: Suffolk Theater
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Gene Casey & the Lone Sharks - show calendar. Check the name and address; research the dance floor.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The theater now brands itself 'The Suffolk' (website thesuffolk.org); the email domain is still suffolktheater.com. Name in our directory ('Suffolk Theater') is fine as an alias. Hours are box-office hours; show times vary. The policies page says dancing may take place at shows (cabaret tables, no dedicated dance floor described). The site says photos and videos are prohibited during performances (an audience rule, not a notice about reusing its own website images). Photo 3 shows a wedding set-up seen from the balcony (people are tiny and not identifiable). Riverhead is in Suffolk County.
hours: Box office: Wed-Sun 11 AM-6 PM; doors, bar and kitchen open 1 hour before each show
description: A restored 1930s Art Deco theater on East Main Street in downtown Riverhead. It hosts concerts, tribute bands, comedy and dance shows, with cabaret-style tables plus row seating and a full bar. The theater says dancing may happen during shows.

logo.alt: The Suffolk logo: the words The Suffolk in red Art Deco capital letters with gold edging (transparent background)

evidence.note: Theater's own site footer: 118 E Main Street, Riverhead NY 11901, 631-727-4343, info@suffolktheater.com; links Facebook TheSuffolkRiverhead and Instagram; lists October 2026 shows.
Policies page: cabaret-style table seating plus row seating; doors, bar and kitchen open 60 minutes before shows; 'dancing may take place'; free parking in the municipal lot behind the theater.
Venue page: performing arts center on Main Street in downtown Riverhead with music, comedy, dance and theater, a full bar and small plates; box office Wed-Sun 11 AM-6 PM.
Google Maps lists it as 'The Suffolk', performing arts theater, 118 E Main St, Riverhead, NY 11901, (631) 727-4343; described as a restored 1930s Art Deco venue.
